coverage_note: Holes: 15:43-16:52 Medi lines are '[speaking foreign language]' (Arabic not transcribed). 04:33-05:00 Medi talks to house staff in English. 03:10-15:41 and 19:51-21:16 mostly English meta talk about the app; Amal's 12:39-15:41 lines are engine MSA translations of her English. Engine writes أديب for قريب (47:11-47:41, both speakers); 42:00 Amal 'وين القلب؟ وين بنحط القلب؟' is likely the engine for 'where do we put el-'. 42:20 'ولاد إمي' vs عمي is a dropped ع (S4), not scored. 1:00:39 'جنين؟' = he misheard جمع (Jenin, name) - listening confusion, not scored. 10:43-10:52 'بطفة/بنفع' unclear example word, skipped. Self-fixes not written: 16:19 بسطت -> انبسطت (before Amal's إنبسطت 16:44), 28:34 ما تشتغلي -> ما بتشتغل, 29:42 تشتـ -> بتشتغل, 43:18 كبير -> كبيرة, 1:02:25 بيروحوا -> بيروح, 56:47 تلاتة -> تلاتاش. Questions not written: 18:24 أكتر إشي وزن or أكتر وزن, 31:50 مهندس الأستاذ?, 39:48 plural here?, 51:10 حفدين/حفيدين, 53:29 اسمه or اسمها. Echo candidates: all six are real English (you know / Tell you about / There's no M? / Uh / Okay / Bye) - no echo fixes. No tier-3 rows: English words used (pounds, venture capital, AI, Utah) are not on her sheet. 44:53 'اثناش بنات' not written: her chat types 'etna3sh banaat'.
